title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
abstract_first: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters).
